stance_rationale: The draft cannot be accepted because the HMM posterior and scale path are generated with full-sample forward-backward smoothing while being represented as forward-filtered PIT output. Tail risk and stress gates also fail under the role prompt caps, despite the package marking no breach.

sigma_audit.method_selected: HMM_3state_mvn_BW_EM; covariance.parquet is stacked 3-state 2x2 [bm_ret,str_ret] covariance, not security-level BΩB'+D

regime_sigma_audit.comment: CRISIS most-likely n=47 is below the <50 bootstrap-CI threshold; no bootstrap CI or pooled fallback artifact was provided.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: NOT_PROVIDED: no TDC, HHI, style correlation, or L-219 family saturation evidence found.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Pipeline estimates HMM on 2004-03-02~2026-05-01 and then writes historical gamma_canon from forward-backward smoothing, so historical scale path uses future observations.
weight_scale_path uses same-date bm_ret, str_ret, vol, and breadth features with no t-1 lag evidence before sizing use.
vol/breadth are computed through anchor date and gamma is smoothed with beta terms; no vol_lag/dd_lag equivalent is shown.
No FRED or external macro series appears in this package; KR price/internal features remain subject to the C1/C2 failures above.
STR_1715 monthly return is an HMM feature used to classify that same month, creating circular regime labels for backtest scale decisions.

critical_concerns.description: The core posterior path is smoothed full-sample output, not a walk-forward forward-filtered signal; using it for historical sizing is future leakage.
Tail gate is mis-scored: CVaR_95=0.1289 exceeds the role cap 0.025, and GFC_2008 cum loss -36.96% plus COVID_2020 -25.12% breach the RF-R4 stress-loss threshold.
CRISIS regime n=47 is below the prompt threshold requiring bootstrap CI, but no bootstrap or pooled fallback is supplied.
The provided covariance is only 2x2 bm_ret/str_ret; exposure_matrix, factor_covariance, and specific_risk artifacts are absent, so BΩB'+D security-level risk is not verified for optimizer handoff.
Method shopping is waived with one candidate and selection_objective='stress_robust'; the required Sample/LW/Gerber/DCC comparison and condition-number objective are missing.
Crowding diagnostics are absent: no TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, or family saturation check is provided.

Package-artifact integrity is inconsistent: risk_package_draft reports n_params=29/AIC=2003.7494/BIC=2118.5813 and a different HMM SHA than lro_params_frozen.json, while artifacts show n_params=50/AIC=2045.7494/BIC=2225.1119.

Required verification artifacts at the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts path plus current weights.csv and alpha_scores.parquet are missing, so schedule fidelity and time-series alpha dimensions cannot be checked.

supporting_arguments: The supplied 2x2 regime covariances are positive definite with worst condition number 11.36499, so the narrow covariance artifact itself does not trip RF-R2/RF-R9.
HMM restarts converged 6/6 and Hill alpha 2.2097 does not trip RF-R6.
Estimated and realized regime switch rates are close at 0.0908 vs 0.0865, but this does not repair the full-sample smoothing leakage.
unresolved_disputes: Whether recommendation_only status is intended to exempt PIT-safe historical evaluation; under AX-002 it should not.
Whether Optimizer will consume scale_effective contemporaneously or with a one-period lag.
Whether inherited STR_1715 security-level covariance exists and is hash-linked to this WT; current package only asserts inheritance.
Whether CVaR cap should be the role prompt default 0.025 or the package's undocumented 0.20 loss threshold.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest assumption is that a full-sample smoothed HMM posterior path can be treated as a frozen forward-filtered PIT risk signal.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate hmm_posterior_path and weight_scale_path using expanding or frozen-parameter forward filtering only, with scale applied at t+1.
Provide bootstrap CI or pooled fallback for CRISIS n=47.
Re-score CVaR_95 and stress gates against the prompt caps or file an infeasibility_report.
Provide security-level BΩB'+D artifacts or hash-verified inherited equivalents.
Add TDC vs PG2, HHI, style correlation, and L-219 family saturation diagnostics.
Resolve package vs artifact AIC/BIC/n_params/transition/hash mismatches.
rationalization_red_flags: single-method WT — no estimator shopping required
CVaR_95 < -0.20 (Pfaff Ch.4 conservative). Realized 0.1289 → no breach.
OOS regime forward-filter only; no re-estimation on new obs

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Codex source cannot pass because the package's central PIT claim is contradicted by the pipeline code and artifacts; Forge/Architect would need independent walk-forward forward-filter verification before 2-source PASS can be counted.

risk_specific_questions: How will the package prove weight_scale_path is computed with gamma_t based only on information available before the next rebalance?
Why is CVaR_95 judged against a 0.20 package threshold instead of the role prompt cap 0.025?
What exact security-level Σ does Optimizer receive if exposure_matrix, factor_covariance, and specific_risk are inherited but not included or hash-linked?
For CRISIS n=47, where is the bootstrap CI or pooled fallback required by RF-R8?
What is the formal definition and sampling axis for TDC vs PG2 active book?
